notes: The packet's variant unit WLC.1SA.7.9.v001 is underdetermined with its qere fallback still among the compatible readings, so it is not a rule 53 case and nothing in the alignment turns on it.

אֶחָד is left unrepresented because the ASV writes only the indefinite article, which rule 15 assigns to the noun of the expression; the competing reading takes the numeral as what a renders, and is named in the unit's note under rule 8.
עוֹלָה takes the supplied for of rule 33 — the nominal carries no marker and no preposition — together with its indefinite article, headed on burnt by rule 31's subtraction.
